prompt: A product manager wants to try different system prompts on a deployed model without writing any code.
why: The chat playground in the Foundry portal is for no-code testing.
trap: The catalog is for choosing a model, not chatting with it.

prompt: In the portal, a developer moves the temperature slider and compares replies to the same question.
why: Adjusting settings and comparing replies happens in the playground.
trap: Temperature is the setting; the question is where you're doing it.

prompt: After a good test chat in the portal, the developer copies sample code that reproduces it in Python.
why: The playground offers 'View code' to move from testing to an app.
trap: The code includes the endpoint, but the action is in the playground.

prompt: Before giving an agent to users, the team chats with it in the portal to check its tool calls and answers.
tells: chats with it in the portal
why: Testing an agent interactively is done in the agents playground.
trap: It is an agent, but the step described is testing in the portal.

prompt: In the portal, a user attaches a folder of PDFs to a chat test so answers come from them, before building an app.
why: The playground can add your data for quick grounded tests.
trap: RAG is the technique; doing it in the portal UI is the playground.

prompt: A designer types prompts into the portal to try an image model before the team builds anything.
why: The images playground lets you try image models without code.
trap: Image generation is the capability; the portal tool is the playground.

prompt: Side by side in the portal, the same prompt is sent to two deployed models to see which answers better.
tells: Side by side in the portal
why: Comparing deployed models interactively happens in the playground.
trap: The catalog compares benchmark numbers; this compares live answers.

prompt: A sales engineer wants to demo a deployed chat model to a customer in a browser, with no app built yet.
why: The portal playground is a ready-made chat UI.
trap: No client app means no endpoint setup needed.
